gloss: to end one's life; to take a life

definitions.gloss: to end one's life; to take one's own life; to kill
definitions.explanation: To bring about death, either one's own or another's. When used reflexively ({自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ), it is a euphemism for suicide. Can also refer to killing another person or creature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{命|いのち}を{絶|た}った。
⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれた。
examples.english: His life was cut short at a young age.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれた。
examples.english: Many soldiers lost their lives on the battlefield.

notes:
A literary and euphemistic expression for death. The construction ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ is a standard euphemism for suicide in Japanese news reporting and formal contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ: to take one's own life (suicide)
- {命|いのち}を{絶|た}たれる: to have one's life taken (passive; killed by another)
- {若|わか}い{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ: to end a young life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to commit suicide — the direct, clinical term
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to lose one's life — neutral; does not imply intent
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to take someone's life — implies forceful killing by another
